comparison_policy.facts: Strict equality of complete facts, including all evidence identities; no fields removed.
comparison_policy.query_ids: Verify UUID5(task_id, subject_id) individually, then compare every other query field.
comparison_policy.input_artifacts: Distinct real tasks own independently created manifests; verify full payload/hash and exact expected artifact refs. Interpretation ref is shared and compared exactly.
comparison_policy.dependency_rows: Compare every scope/version/type/work/branch; context and dependency row IDs are local.
comparison_policy.order: Alternate baseline/candidate first for every pair. Task setup and persistence inspection excluded.

limitations: Same shared development host, not an isolated production benchmark or latency SLO.
One workload, one process, five default pairs per size; no confidence interval or 200-Agent claim.
PostgreSQL/OS buffers remain warm; no buffer flush or cold-disk claim.
Payload hash reuse and SQL batching change together; their timing effects are not isolated.
Baseline query class uses the shared current repository with verified unchanged original add method.
Original unpaired runs remain recorded and are not promoted to strict semantic equality.

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-0+deb13u1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
environment.sql_count_scope: SQLAlchemy cursor execution during context_compile only; excludes task setup, post-compile inspection, pool pre-ping and result decoding

independent_world_identity_diagnosis.reason: The later accepted SET_RELATION closes the initial relation and appends its event reference. Querying the earlier point keeps that historical record's evidence, qualified by the run's WorldRef. Independently generated event/world identities differ even when scalar values are equal.
independent_world_identity_diagnosis.original_unpaired_limitation: Old before/after JSON retained hashes, not full facts. This is a new causal reproduction, not a recovered comparison of old facts.
